newsitem.title: USA: Man charged in fetus death after fender bender.
newsitem.headline: Man charged in fetus death after fender bender.

text.p: A Pennsylvania man involved in what appeared to be a minor traffic accident has been charged with vehicular homicide in the death hours later of an unborn child, police said on Thursday.
Thomas Sherwood, 47, of Coraopolis, Pennsylvania, is among the first to be charged under new Ohio laws on causing the death of a foetus.
If convicted of vehicular homicide, a first-degree misdemeanor, he could face up to six months in jail.

Sherwood was initially charged with failure to yield at a stop sign, but the pregnant driver of the other car was admitted to a local hospital and her child was delivered stillborn several hours later, Alliance police said.

Fannie Welsh, 28, of Alliance, who was nearly seven months pregnant, complained of minor back pain at the accident scene but was admitted to the hospital for observation because she was pregnant, a police spokesman said.
"It was a relatively minor accident," he said, adding that neither Sherwood nor an eight-year-old girl in the car with Welsh was injured.
